# Broadway TS

Broadway TS is a TypeScript-first CQRS and Event Sourcing toolkit inspired by
Broadway for PHP.

Docs entry points:
- Overview: /
- Getting started: /getting-started
- Bank account tutorial: /tutorials/bank-account
- Command/query bus guide: /guides/command-query-bus
- Event sourcing guide: /guides/event-sourcing
- Testing guide: /guides/testing
- Core reference: /reference/core
- Event sourcing reference: /reference/event-sourcing
- Zod reference: /reference/zod
- Testing reference: /reference/testing
- Postgres reference: /reference/postgres
- Roadmap: /roadmap
- Generated API docs: /api/

Package boundaries:
- @broadway-ts/core: Result, errors, schema contract, command/query definitions, buses, middleware.
- @broadway-ts/event-sourcing: event definitions, envelopes, EventStore, aggregate base, repository.
- @broadway-ts/zod: Zod adapter for Schema<T>.
- @broadway-ts/testing: in-memory event store, fixed clock, deterministic IDs, aggregate scenarios.
- @broadway-ts/postgres: placeholder for future Postgres EventStore adapter.

Current status: prototype, not published to npm yet.
